notes.title: Cross play with Xbox Update
notes.notes:
🍄 Shroom Siege Demo Now Cross-Play with Xbox! ⚔️
Big news, mushroom warriors! 🌟

The Shroom Siege demo is now live on Xbox as part of the Xbox Indie Selects Demo Fest 2025 — and starting today, we’ve added full cross-play support with Steam!

That means whether you’re defending shrines or pushing poop with your trusty beetle, you can now team up with friends across Xbox and Steam in chaotic 4v4 online battles.
🆕 What’s New:
🔗 Cross-Play Multiplayer – Steam + Xbox players, united in battle

⚔️ Bigger Community – More warriors, more action, more mushroom mayhem

🗺️ Two New Maps Added to the Demo! – Fresh battlegrounds to explore and conquer

This is just the beginning—your feedback during the demo will help us fine-tune balance and prepare for the full release in 2025.

👉 Play the Demo on Steam

🍄⚔️ Siege together, anywhere!
🍄 NEW MAPS!!!! 🐝🐝🐝🐝
